title: Memory
subtitle: What agents learned while working on {{computer}}. Agents recall it when it fits the task.
subtitleProject: What agents learned while working in {{root}}. Agents recall it when it fits the task.
allRealms.title: Pick a realm to see its memory
allRealms.body: Memory is kept per realm. Pick one from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square), or show Global.
subtitleWide: Lessons and slots agents keep for every project in {{realm}}.
scope.label: Memory of
st.cold.title: Memory for realm {{realm}} is not connected on {{computer}} right now
st.cold.body: It connects while the realm is in use on {{computer}}. Try again in a moment.
st.unreachable.title: Cannot reach memory right now
st.unreachable.body: Try again in a moment. Nothing was changed.
st.degraded.title: Memory for realm {{realm}} can't be read right now
st.degraded.body: Try again in a moment. Nothing was changed.
st.off.title: Nothing is stored in realm {{realm}}
st.off.body: Memory is off for this realm. Turn it on under Details to let agents remember what they learn.
st.empty.title: Nothing is stored in realm {{realm}} yet
st.empty.body: Agents add to memory as they work.
st.partial: Some of memory's counts could not be read.

d.error: This record could not be read
d.missing: This memory wasn’t found in realm {{realm}}. It may have been deleted, or it is in another realm.
d.stale: This record could not be read again. What is shown may be out of date, so it cannot be changed until it reads again.
d.older: This is an older version of this memory. A newer version replaced it, so this one cannot be edited or deleted.
f.name: Slot
edit.title: Edit this record
edit.lede: Agents recall the new text from now on. Its history is kept.
edit.strengthHelp: 1 is the weakest, 10 the strongest: stronger memories are recalled first.
edit.daysBad: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{max}}.
edit.needDays: Enter the number of days to save.
edit.empty: Write something: an empty record cannot be saved.
edit.held: This edit may have gone through. Nothing is sent again. Check again reads the record.
edit.conflict: Another edit changed or replaced this memory first, so yours was not saved. Reload reads its latest version; your words stay here.
edit.gone: This memory is no longer there, so this edit cannot be saved. Your words are still here to copy.
edit.heldExpiry: This edit may have gone through. Nothing is sent again. Reading the record cannot confirm a new forget date: check its Forgotten after, then press Stop tracking.
edit.heldExpiryNew: This edit may have gone through. Nothing is sent again. If it did, the agent saved it as a new version of this memory, one Version higher, so the date on this page does not change: open that version from the list and check its Forgotten after, then press Stop tracking.
edit.heldElsewhere: An edit of this record sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
del.title: Delete this record?
del.body: Agents stop recalling it. This cannot be undone.
del.held: Deleting this record may have gone through. Check again reads it; nothing is sent again.
del.heldElsewhere: A delete of this record sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
del.waits: Another delete in this list is on its way or waiting to be checked. Deletes in one list run one at a time, so this record can be deleted once that one is answered, checked or no longer tracked.
many.held_one: Deleting {{count}} record may have gone through. Check again reads it; nothing is sent again.
many.held_other: Deleting {{count}} records may have gone through, all or some of them. Check again reads each one; nothing is sent again.
many.heldPart: {{gone}} of the {{count}} records are gone; the rest may still be deleted. Check again reads them again; nothing is sent again.
many.heldElsewhere: A delete of several records of this list sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
many.waits: A delete of one record in this list is on its way or waiting to be checked. Deletes in one list run one at a time, so Delete selected waits until that one is answered, checked or no longer tracked.
many.dismissBody: Some or all of them may still have been deleted. Read the list again before you delete them again.
held.dismissBody: It may still have gone through. Read the record again before you change it.
held.notice.edit: An edit of a record in this project may have gone through.
held.notice.remove: A delete of a record in this project may have gone through.
held.notice.removeMany: A delete of several records in this project may have gone through.
det.state.leader: Leader: this computer keeps the realm’s memory
det.state.follower: Follower: another computer keeps the realm’s memory
det.state.stuck: Choosing a memory host is stuck
det.state.not_realm_member: This computer is not a member of the realm
det.state.fleet_disabled: Shared memory off: memory is local
det.noHosts: No computer is serving this realm's memory right now.
det.switch: Agents remember what they learn in realm {{realm}}
det.switchNote: Turns memory on or off for every agent in realm {{realm}} on {{computer}}. What is stored stays.
det.unknown: Whether memory is on is not known right now.
det.held: Turning memory {{state}} may have gone through. Check again reads it; nothing is sent again.
det.heldElsewhere: A memory on/off change sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
det.totalsNote: Store totals count every version of a memory and include the realm-wide space; project numbers count current memories only.
det.unread: The agent could not read these numbers right now.
det.embed.label: Embedded for recall
det.embed.off: Embeddings are off. Search can use word and graph matches.
det.embed.unread: Could not be read right now
scope.noManage: Global memory can be edited, deleted and switched on or off here. Tidying, erasing, writing pending memory and choosing a memory computer are available only for realm memory.
scope.closed.title: Global memory is not open to this sign-in
scope.closed.body: This sign-in reaches one realm only.
create.title: New memory
create.lede: Agents working in this project recall it from now on.
create.needList: Saving waits until this project's memories have been read.
create.listFailed: This project's memories could not be read, so this cannot be saved yet. Try again reads them.
create.held: This new memory may have been saved. Nothing is sent again. Check again looks for a memory in this project with exactly these words and settings.
create.heldExpiry: This new memory may have been saved. Nothing is sent again. A read cannot confirm a memory set to be forgotten after some days: look for it in the Memories list, then press Stop tracking.
create.heldElsewhere: A new memory sent from another place may have been saved. It is checked there.
create.foundHeld: Found it: a memory in this project has exactly these words and settings now. It may be this save, or one another agent or person saved. Open it to check, then press Stop tracking.
create.dismissBody: It may still have been saved. Look for it in the Memories list before you save it again.
rel.unread: The relations could not be read
rel.unreadBody: The agent answered without the relations. Try again in a moment.
rel.partial: Some of the relations could not be read, so this page may be incomplete
rel.dirty: Shown from a saved copy while the agent refreshes it
rel.title: Relations
rel.noneOnPage: None of its links are with the entities read with it
rel.pageOnly: {{shown}} of its {{count}} links are with the entities read with it
rel.readSoFar: Relations are listed only between the {{shown}} most-linked entities read so far, of {{count}}
